tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Run a fresh Web Scan audit of a public URL and return its score (0-100), grade, and every failing or warning check with its id, title and fix: the result is complete in itself. reportUrl is a shareable link only when the request carries a signed-in Web Scan token (reports are saved for signed-in use

tools.name: verify_fixes
tools.description: Re-scan a URL after you deployed fixes and report, per check id, whether it now passes (fixed: true), plus the new score, the previous score, what is still failing with its fix, and allFixed. Use this after a change reaches production (or a public preview) instead of asking the user to re-scan. Pass

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Read a stored Web Scan report by its slug (the part after /r/ in a web-scan.agentmarket.lol/r/<slug> link) without re-scanning: score, grade, scan time and the failing or warning checks with fixes. Use this when the user shares a report link. Reports expire after two weeks; to check the current stat

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "scan_url" stacks urgency/override words (always, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_url, verify_fixes · Private data: scan_url · Public sink: scan_url · Destructive: scan_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_url, verify_fixes · Private data: scan_url · Public sink: scan_url · Destructive: scan_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
